name: Ninh Binh
provinceNote: Ninh Binh province now also includes the former Ha Nam and Nam Dinh provinces.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A limestone valley of rice and river caves south of Hanoi. Row a sampan through Tràng An, climb the Hang Múa stair over the paddies, and walk the temples at Hoa Lư.
timeNeeded: One night, or two if you add Kim Sơn or Vân Long
fee: No single city ticket. Each site has its own.
getThere: SE7 from Hà Nội is 06:00–08:16, 2 hours 16 minutes, at kilometre 115.
seoTitle: Ninh Binh travel guide — Trang An sampan, Hang Mua, and Hoa Lu
seoDescription: A sampan at Tràng An, the Hang Múa stair over the rice, and the temples at Hoa Lư. The train from Hà Nội reaches Ga Ninh Bình in a little over two hours.
intro: You come to sit in a sampan at Tràng An, climb Hang Múa over the rice, and walk the temples at Hoa Lư. Tràng An is a sampan on sông Sào Khê, rowed between towers up to about 200 m, about 90 km southeast of Hà Nội. The Tam Coc boat is a different ticket.

Hang Múa is the stair over the paddies, 150,000 đồng per person. Hoa Lư, at xã Trường Yên, is the capital of the Đinh, the Tiền Lê, and the early Lý. An adult temple ticket is 20,000 đồng. Am Tiên, about 400 m from the east gate, is a separate 100,000 đồng line. Bái Đính is the pagoda hill in phường Tây Hoa Lư, about 20 km from the provincial centre and about 100 km from Hà Nội. That 100 km is a different end from Tràng An’s about 90 km.

The train from Hà Nội is the practical arrival. SE7 leaves at 06:00 and reaches Ninh Bình at 08:16, 2 hours 16 minutes. The timetable puts the station at kilometre 115. The station is đường Ngô Gia Tự, phường Hoa Lư, between ga Cát Đằng and ga Cầu Yên. Sleep near Tràng An when the sampan is the morning. Sleep by the station when the train is late.

Give the valley one night when the sampan, the stair, and the temples are the trip. Add a second night for Vân Long or the church at Kim Sơn. Vân Long is placed at xã Gia Vân and also at huyện Gia Viễn. Vietnamese pages call 2019 the year it became Vietnam’s 9th Ramsar site. A Ramsar record for site 2360 shows 10 February 2017. Phát Diệm, at xã Lưu Phương, was built from 1875 to 1898.

Cơm cháy is the crisp rice you can see, and the goat plates are on the roads toward the sights. Breakfast, where the 5 November 2024 tourism article names a street, is Phố ăn sáng Vân Giang. The evening on the ticket list is a lamp boat on hồ Kỳ Lân at Phố cổ Hoa Lư. The visit is free. The boat is 100,000 đồng for an adult, and the same for a child over 1.29 m. A child under 1.29 m is 80,000 đồng. The VIP boat is 150,000 đồng, and 100,000 đồng for a child under 1.29 m. Hotline 0915 299 377.
gettingAround: Ga Ninh Bình is the city stop. Southbound trains that stop are SE7 06:00–08:16, SE5 08:00–10:16, SE9 13:00–15:17, SE3 19:20–21:36, and SE1 21:45–00:03 the next day. SE10 does not stop. Northbound, SE8 is 2 hours 21 minutes, SE6 is 2 hours 19 minutes, SE4 is 2 hours 22 minutes, and SE2 is 2 hours 18 minutes.

From the station, the valley is a ride. Sleep near Tràng An when the sampan is the morning. Sleep by the station when the train is late. SE1 arrives at 00:03. The culture office at 29 Lê Đại Hành is not the station. The tourism office at 06 Tràng An is not the station.

eat: Cơm cháy is the crisp rice, and goat is on the roads toward the sights. Breakfast is Phố ăn sáng Vân Giang. The food guide lists the dishes and every door on the 30 June 2025 provincial list.
interestsBody: Cơm cháy and the goat plates start the day. The food guide is the menu.
The sampan is sông Sào Khê at Tràng An. Hang Múa is the rice view. Hoa Lư is the old capital in the same valley.
The lamp boat on hồ Kỳ Lân is the evening. Bái Đính is the pagoda hill. Phát Diệm is the stone church at Kim Sơn.

blocks.heading: The sampan
paragraphs: You sit low in the boat and a local guide rows. An adult over 1.3 m pays 300,000 đồng, a child from 1 m to 1.3 m pays 150,000 đồng, and a child under 1 m is free, on the board updated 30 March 2026. Đảo Khê Cốc is a separate ticket: 100,000 đồng and 50,000 đồng on those same lines. Hotline 19009251. Support phone 02293.886.068.
A 2017 tourism itinerary gives 31 lakes and 48 caves. UNESCO gives no cave count. About 14,000 residents are listed with the property.

cards.title: Tràng An
cards.summary: Sampans on sông Sào Khê. Adult 300,000 đồng. The Tam Coc boat is a different ticket.

interestGroups.title: Old capital
interestGroups.summary: The temples at Trường Yên, and the lamp boat after dark.

blocks.heading: Đền Đinh and đền Lê
paragraphs: Six kings are named: Đinh Tiên Hoàng, Đinh Toàn, Lê Đại Hành, Lê Trung Tông, Lê Long Đĩnh, and Lý Thái Tổ. An adult ticket is 20,000 đồng. A child aged 6 to 15 is 10,000 đồng, and so is a visitor aged 60 or over, and a disabled visitor. Hotline 02293 620 099. Support phone 02293.621.890.
Am Tiên is about 400 m from the east gate of đền Đinh, up 205 steps. Adult 100,000 đồng, child under 1.3 m 30,000 đồng. Hotline 0987807965.

blocks.heading: The lamp boat
paragraphs: Phố cổ Hoa Lư is free to visit. The hồ Kỳ Lân boat, with lamps, is 100,000 đồng for an adult and for a child over 1.29 m. A child under 1.29 m is 80,000 đồng. The VIP boat is 150,000 đồng, and 100,000 đồng for a child under 1.29 m. Hotline 0915 299 377.

cards.title: Hoa Lư
cards.summary: The tombs on núi Mã Yên and the two temples. Adult 20,000 đồng. Am Tiên is a separate line.

interestGroups.title: The pagoda hill
interestGroups.summary: Bái Đính, old foundation and the new hill.

blocks.heading: Carts
paragraphs: The old foundation dates to Nguyễn Minh Không in 1136, and the new complex to an expansion from 2003. UNESCO places the reconstructed complex in the buffer.

Return electric cart: adult 150,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 100,000 đồng. The transfer package is 300,000 đồng and 210,000 đồng on those lines. A VIP cart with a guide on the cart is 4,000,000 đồng. A guide is 500,000 đồng a tour. Hotline 1900 966 909. The 2017 itinerary says 500 arhat statues and bells of 36 tons and 27 tons. The bell photograph is captioned at 36 tons, 10 m high, diameter 5 m.

cards.title: Bái Đính
cards.summary: Lit towers at Tây Hoa Lư. A return electric cart is 150,000 đồng for an adult.

interestGroups.title: The rice view
interestGroups.summary: Climb Hang Múa for the paddies and the towers.

blocks.heading: The stair
paragraphs: The ticket is 150,000 đồng per person on the board updated 30 March 2026. Hotline 0987 111 312. Support phone 02293.619.679. The river in the view is the Tam Coc side.

cards.title: Hang Múa
cards.summary: Rice, karst, and the steps. 150,000 đồng per person.

interestGroups.title: The wetland
interestGroups.summary: Vân Long, the boat that is not the Sao Khe.

blocks.heading: The wetland
paragraphs: The tourism account places it at xã Gia Vân. The conservation account places it at huyện Gia Viễn. Vietnamese pages call 2019 the year it became Vietnam’s 9th Ramsar site, and the tourism account also calls it the 2nd Ramsar site of the Red River Delta. A Ramsar record for site 2360 shows 10 February 2017. The point 20°23′35″N 105°51′10″E is the wetland. The conservation account names the Pù Luông–Cúc Phương limestone as the range this wetland sits on.
Adult entry is 100,000 đồng. A child is 50,000 đồng, with no height on that line. Hotline 0963 106 222. Support phone 0915.431.058.

cards.title: Vân Long
cards.summary: Wetland water and limestone. Adult 100,000 đồng. The address is given as Gia Vân and as Gia Viễn.

interestGroups.title: The stone church
interestGroups.summary: Phát Diệm at Kim Sơn, a ride out from the karst.

blocks.heading: Kim Sơn
paragraphs: The complex was built from 1875 to 1898 by Đức cha Phê rô Trần Lục, at xã Lưu Phương. Kim Sơn’s reclamation dates to Nguyễn Công Trứ in 1829. Nhà thờ Lớn is described with six rows of lim columns, and the same account gives both 52 columns and 16 columns. It became a national relic in 1987. Support phone 02293.862.058.

cards.title: Phát Diệm
cards.summary: The stone front and the wooden nave.

faqs.a: Sleep in the Tràng An valley when the sampan is the morning. Sleep by Ga Ninh Bình when the train is late. SE1 arrives at 00:03.

faqs.q: How do you get there from Hanoi?
faqs.a: SE7 leaves Hà Nội at 06:00 and reaches Ninh Bình at 08:16, 2 hours 16 minutes. The timetable puts the station at kilometre 115. Later southbound stops are SE5, SE9, SE3, and SE1. SE10 does not stop.

faqs.q: What does the Tràng An ticket cost?
faqs.a: On the board updated 30 March 2026, an adult over 1.3 m pays 300,000 đồng, a child from 1 m to 1.3 m pays 150,000 đồng, and a child under 1 m is free. Đảo Khê Cốc is separate, at 100,000 đồng and 50,000 đồng.

faqs.q: When is the Hoa Lư festival?
faqs.a: The provincial account gives the 8th through the 10th of lunar month 3, with a large festival every three years. The heritage account gives the 10th. No solar date is fixed.

season.label: Hoa Lư in lunar month 3
season.note: Hoa Lư falls on the 8th through the 10th of lunar month 3 on the provincial account, with a large festival every three years. The heritage account gives the 10th. No solar date is fixed.
